page.overview:
Who is AM-501?

AM-501 was a human female stormtrooper who served the First Order.

AM-501 appeared in the VR game Star Wars: Tales from the Galaxy's Edge – Last Call. Although her name isn't spoken aloud in Tales from the Galaxy's Edge – Last Call, she was identified in the subtitles for the game.
